articles.title: Einstein's Gravity Tested with Exotic Muonium Atoms
articles.summary: Physicists in Switzerland are preparing to drop muonium—a weird, short-lived atom—to see if gravity treats it like ordinary matter. It's the first test of its kind.

articles.title: 3D-Printed Harness Helps Injured Sea Turtle Recover
articles.summary: A green sea turtle named Cebu, hit by a boat, is learning to swim again with a custom 3D-printed harness and stem cell therapy at a Georgia center.

articles.title: Anak Krakatau Eruption Sends Ash 50,000 Feet High, Disrupts Thousands of Flights
articles.summary: Indonesia's Anak Krakatau volcano erupted for over 24 hours, sending ash 10 miles high, closing eight airports, and disrupting nearly 3,000 flights.
